Context: ExcEPTIONS:-

9. A Government servant quitting service on resignation will not be entitled to any pension, gratuity or terminal benefits. He will, however, be paid suo motu, cash equivalent to the extent of half of earned leave at his credit on the date of cessation of service, subject to a maximum of 150 days. HPL will lapse. - Rule 26 (1) of CCS (Pension) Rules and Rule 39 (6) (a) (ii) of CCS (Leave) Rules.
